desc:
✈️ Ever wanted to be a Pilot?✈️  In this game you can experience being a fighter pilot, flying jets, doing missions, flying with friends, and LOTS more including dogfighting! Fly together to different airports or aircraft carriers and explore the islands! There are many other things you can do such as, flying drones, multiplayer dogfights, refuel planes in the sky, and even maybe doing flyovers or airshows! The plane models are advanced and have hard but not too hard of controls so you can easily fly your aircraft! 

✈️Become an ATC and control the airport all at your own hands! Buy the ATC gamepass which allows you to guide planes!

If you like aviation, Pilot Training Flight Simulator, or any plane game you will probably like this game with our wide variety of all type of aviation aircraft! We go from small planes to giant planes. Fly any AVIATION plane you want.
